findings.title: Privileged transfer lacks authorization
findings.description: A public entry point reaches the privileged transfer path without checking the caller.
findings.impact: An arbitrary account can transfer assets held by another account.
findings.recommendation: Require an authorized role before entering the privileged transfer path.
